description.zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**不一样。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** may be different for each API request.

description.zh:
地址池实例的描述。

长度为0-256个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
description.en:
The description of the IP address pool instance.

The description must be 0 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh: 要进行迁移的连续EIP组的实例ID。
description.en: The instance ID of the contiguous EIP group to migrate.

description.zh:
地址池实例的名称。

长度为0-128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
description.en:
The name of the IP address pool instance.

The name must be 0 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh: 连续EIP组所属的地域ID。您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en: The region ID of the contiguous EIP group. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.
The resource group ID of the IP address pool.

title.en: Migrate a contiguous EIP group to an IP address pool

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc transform-eip-segment-to-public-ip-address-pool --instance-id eipsg-2zett8ba055tbsxme0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --name AddressPoolName --description AddressPoolDescription --resource-group-id rg-acfmxazb4pcdvf0000 --client-token 02fb3da4-130e-110000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun vpc TransformEipSegmentToPublicIpAddressPool --region cn-hangzhou --Description AddressPoolDescription --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmxazb4pcdvf0000' --InstanceId 'eipsg-2zett8ba055tbsxme0000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken '02fb3da4-130e-110000' --Name AddressPoolName
